title: Harud Ka Ding Ba Rhem (Beside the Glowing Hearth Fire)
cultural_context: Intimate fireside song sung on cold winter highland evenings as children gather around the three sacred hearth stones (*ki mawbyrsiew*).

khasi: Harud ka ding ba rhem ngi shong marwei lang,
U kseh u pynbthei ia ki phylliah ding,
Ka mei-rad ka iathuh ia ki khanatang barim,
Ba u briew u la long uba shlur bad uba hok.
english: Beside the glowing hearth fire we sit close together,
The resinous pine logs crackle with golden sparks,
Grandmother recounts ancient tales of old,
How our people lived fearless, righteous, and true.

vocabulary.phylliah-ding: flying golden sparks of resinous pine

lyrics_khasi:
Harud ka ding ba rhem ngi shong marwei lang,

lyrics_english:
Beside the glowing hearth fire we sit close together,
